A '''Bat Wing''' is a type of [[Monster Loot]] dropped by [[Bats]] (any variant except for Iridium Bats) when slain. 10 Bat Wings can also be purchased for {{Price|30}} each from [[Krobus]] on [[Days of the Week#Sunday|Sundays]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

The [[Desert Trader]] in [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]] will trade one [[Butterfly Hutch]] for 200 Bat Wings.

==Tailoring==
Bat Wing is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt003.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Dark Shirt]].

==Quests==
*Ten Bat Wings are requested by [[Void Salmon]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.
*Ten Bat Wings may be requested by [[Catfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
*Twenty Bat Wings may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
